title: feat(nu12): B12 still reverses (4,0,0) vs (2,2,2); doubled pair does not
science: Important scale-dependence negative: on B_12(0) nu still reverses the original diamond (1200>1024) but FAILS the doubled-scale pair, t(8,0,0)=14 vs t(4,4,4)=14 giving 2352 < 3136. So the nu anisotropy correction is not scale-invariant -- it is a short-distance effect that dies at twice the scale. Also repeats the host-boundary anomaly (t(8,0,0)=14 on B_12 vs 16 on B_8) with explicit witnessing paths, and var_nu=0.006661 < var_l1=0.009447.
verdict_pair: reverse=YES at (4,0,0)/(2,2,2); reverse=NO at doubled (8,0,0)/(4,4,4). face=absent
